Path: the road — start: signing in when the server is down | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. Direction as the body proposes

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:29Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/LoginPage.tsx` and `signUpOffer.ts` ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`); paths re-read on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`.

- **Why p3:** the user cannot sign in either way; the page only fails to say why.
- **Direction:**
  - when the config reads fail, show "Can't reach the server" with Retry in place of the form
  - offer Sign up only once the registration posture is known
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU`
Account: `os-bill`
Branch: `claude/issue-11806-login-server-unreachable`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-11806`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface (on `b0aa892`):
- `apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`: the console's own login page, which the QA pass reached. When its config reads fail it shows "can't reach the server" with Retry instead of a live-looking form, and it offers Sign up only once the registration posture is known.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/LoginPage.tsx` (`DefaultLoginPage`): the same rule, inside the component. Its props stay as they are.
- The tests beside these, and `.changeset/11806-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it:
- `decideSignUpOffer`, `SignUpOfferContext` and `SignUpOffer` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/signUpOffer.ts`. They are exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` (`:282`–`:288`), so a change to their signature or answers is a published-surface change. The page decides whether to render the offer at all; it does not change the shared rule's answers.
- `RegisterPage.tsx` / `ForgotPasswordPage.tsx` on either side, and `packages/auth/**` (`LoginForm`, `useAuth`).
- `packages/i18n/**`. The strings come from existing keys: `console.*.error.connectionFailed` / `serverUnreachable` / `checkServer` and `retry`, at about `:2087`–`:2095` of `en.ts`.
- `packages/components/src/ui/**`.

Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over these paths: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui console login page: when the server's config reads (runtime/config, auth/config, i18n, get-session) fail, the form renders as if live and, with auth config unknown, offers Sign up | none: the page holds the failed reads itself and is the only place that can say so | every user who opens the console while the backend is down, measured by the filer in the 2026-10-07 QA pass (seven 502s, a live-looking form, Sign up offered)`
Thread-read: 6043228771
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking.
- **In-flight `pm:dispatched` claims, read 2026-10-08T03:09Z:** none names `LoginPage`, `signUpOffer` or `console/auth`.
- **`apps/console`:** seat 1's objectui#11798 (chunking and routes) is no longer in flight.
- **Open objectui PRs, read 2026-10-08T03:09Z:** none touches these files.

Why `Clause-②: no`: no export, prop or accepted value changes, and the strings reuse existing published keys. If an existing key does not fit and a new `packages/i18n` key is needed, the dev reports it before opening the PR. The same goes for a change to the exported sign-up decision. In either case the seat re-claims with `Clause-②: yes`: a `minor` changeset and a contract-review record before the queue.
